name: Chunk 1/25

raw_entities.name: Cybersecurity Incident
raw_entities.description: A security event involving unauthorized access, malware, ransomware, or other cyber threats to FirstUK Bank systems, data, or infrastructure. This is a top-level incident category requiring coordinated response from Technology and Security teams.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized access to, disclosure of, or loss of customer or operational data. Requires immediate investigation, regulatory notification, and customer communication.

raw_entities.name: System Outage
raw_entities.description: An unplanned interruption to banking systems, services, or infrastructure affecting customer access or transaction processing. Requires rapid detection, containment, and recovery actions.

raw_entities.name: Operational Failure
raw_entities.description: A failure in banking operational processes, procedures, or controls that impacts service delivery, compliance, or customer outcomes. Covered under the FirstUK Bank Incident Response Plan.

raw_entities.name: Severity 1 (Critical)
raw_entities.description: The highest severity classification for incidents with catastrophic impact — including major financial loss, widespread customer impact, extended system outage, or regulatory breach. Requires immediate escalation and executive notification.

raw_entities.name: Severity 2 (High)
raw_entities.description: A high-severity incident with significant impact on operations, customer service, or data security. Requires rapid response and senior management notification.

raw_entities.name: Severity 3 (Medium)
raw_entities.description: A medium-severity incident with moderate impact on operations or limited customer scope. Requires investigation and standard escalation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Severity 4 (Low)
raw_entities.description: A low-severity incident with minimal impact on operations or isolated customer effect. Requires documentation and standard handling procedures.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The primary banking organization subject to this Incident Response Plan. Operates under the governance of Technology, Operations, Executive, and Board oversight.

raw_entities.name: Chief Information Security Officer
raw_entities.description: The executive owner of the Incident Response Plan responsible for oversight, approval, and escalation of security incidents at FirstUK Bank.

raw_entities.name: Technology Department
raw_entities.description: The primary operational team responsible for incident detection, containment, and recovery. Listed as document owner and primary audience.

raw_entities.name: Operations Department
raw_entities.description: The operational team responsible for business continuity, customer communication, and incident coordination during response activities.

raw_entities.name: Executive Leadership
raw_entities.description: Senior management and executive stakeholders who must be notified of critical incidents and major escalations.

raw_entities.name: Board of Directors
raw_entities.description: The Board of Directors of FirstUK Bank, identified as an audience for the Incident Response Plan and requiring notification of critical incidents.

raw_entities.name: Information Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A related policy document governing information security practices at FirstUK Bank, referenced in the Incident Response Plan.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Policy
raw_entities.description: A related policy document governing operational risk management at FirstUK Bank, referenced in the Incident Response Plan.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Matrix
raw_entities.description: A related reference document defining escalation procedures and contact chains for incident response at FirstUK Bank.
